sentences: I’ll explain how you can get to the City Library from the school.
The best way to get there is to take the bus.
You can take bus No. 2 or 5, and it’ll only take about 10 minutes.
The painting I want to write about is The Red Room by Henri Matisse.
This painting shows a red room with a window.
In the room, there are two chairs and a big table.
We also see a woman who is setting the table.
I like the red color of this painting.
I think that the room feels warm because of it.
People take pictures of their faces and stick them on the street.
The pictures come together to create a huge artwork.
People write their dreams and goals on a big wall.
They share their stories and make a special artwork together.
In the past, my grandparents used to live in the country.
Now they live in a city.
In the past, they used to work on the farm.
Now they do not work, and they enjoy traveling.

items.statement_ko: 화자는 학교에서 시립 도서관까지 가는 방법을 설명하고 있다.
items.why_ko: 학교에서 City Library까지 가는 법을 설명한다고 했다.
_evidence_text: I’ll explain how you can get to the City Library from the school.
items.statement_en: The speaker is telling someone how to go from the school to the City Library.

items.statement_ko: 거기에 가는 가장 좋은 방법은 지하철을 타는 것이다.
items.why_ko: 가장 좋은 방법은 버스를 타는 것이라고 했다.
_evidence_text: The best way to get there is to take the bus.
items.statement_en: According to the speaker, the best way to get there is by subway.

items.why_ko: bus No. 2 or 5로 약 10분이 걸린다고 했다.
_evidence_text: You can take bus No. 2 or 5, and it’ll only take about 10 minutes.
items.statement_en: If you ride bus No. 2 or No. 5, the trip takes only about 10 minutes.

items.statement_ko: 화자가 글로 쓰고 싶은 그림은 앙리 마티스의 'The Red Room'이다.
items.why_ko: The Red Room by Henri Matisse라고 밝혔다.
_evidence_text: The painting I want to write about is The Red Room by Henri Matisse.
items.statement_en: The speaker wants to write about Henri Matisse's painting 'The Red Room.'

items.statement_ko: 이 그림은 창문이 하나도 없는 빨간 방을 보여 준다.
items.why_ko: 창문이 있는 빨간 방을 보여 준다고 했다.
_evidence_text: This painting shows a red room with a window.
items.statement_en: The painting shows a red room that has no window at all.

items.statement_ko: 방 안에는 의자 두 개와 큰 탁자가 있다.
items.why_ko: two chairs and a big table이 있다고 했다.
_evidence_text: In the room, there are two chairs and a big table.
items.statement_en: Inside the room, you can find two chairs and a large table.

items.statement_ko: 그림 속에서 상을 차리고 있는 사람은 한 남자이다.
_evidence_text: We also see a woman who is setting the table.
items.statement_en: The person putting the food and dishes on the table in the painting is a man.

items.statement_ko: 화자는 이 그림의 파란색을 좋아한다고 말했다.
_evidence_text: I like the red color of this painting.
items.statement_en: The speaker says that he likes the blue color of this painting.

items.statement_ko: 화자는 그 색 때문에 방이 따뜻하게 느껴진다고 생각한다.
items.why_ko: 그 색 때문에 방이 warm하게 느껴진다고 했다.
_evidence_text: I think that the room feels warm because of it.
items.statement_en: The speaker feels that the color makes the room seem warm.

items.statement_ko: 사람들은 자기 얼굴 사진을 찍어 거리에 붙인다.
items.why_ko: 얼굴 사진을 찍어 거리에 붙인다고 했다.
_evidence_text: People take pictures of their faces and stick them on the street.
items.statement_en: People take photos of their own faces and put them up on the street.

items.statement_ko: 그 사진들이 모여서 거대한 예술 작품을 만든다.
items.why_ko: 사진들이 모여 huge artwork를 만든다고 했다.
_evidence_text: The pictures come together to create a huge artwork.
items.statement_en: All those photos are put together and become one very big artwork.

items.statement_ko: 사람들은 자신의 꿈과 목표를 작은 종이에 적어 나눠 준다.
items.why_ko: 큰 벽(a big wall)에 꿈과 목표를 쓴다고 했다.
_evidence_text: People write their dreams and goals on a big wall.
items.statement_en: People write their dreams and goals on small pieces of paper and hand them out.

items.statement_ko: 사람들은 서로 이야기를 나누며 함께 특별한 작품을 만든다.
items.why_ko: 이야기를 공유하고 함께 특별한 작품을 만든다고 했다.
_evidence_text: They share their stories and make a special artwork together.
items.statement_en: People tell each other their stories and build one special artwork together.

_evidence_text: In the past, my grandparents used to live in the country.
items.statement_en: The speaker's grandparents lived in a city a long time ago.

items.why_ko: Now they live in a city라고 했다.
_evidence_text: Now they live in a city.
items.statement_en: These days the grandparents live in a city.

items.why_ko: 예전에는 농장(on the farm)에서 일했다고 했다.
_evidence_text: In the past, they used to work on the farm.
items.statement_en: In the past, the grandparents worked in a factory.

items.statement_ko: 조부모는 지금도 일을 계속하고 있어서 여행을 즐기지 못한다.
items.why_ko: 지금은 일을 하지 않고 여행을 즐긴다고 했다.
_evidence_text: Now they do not work, and they enjoy traveling.
items.statement_en: The grandparents still work now, so they cannot enjoy traveling.
